name: E6

images.credit: Grzegorz828, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM 850 / 900 / 1800 / 1900, GPRS/EDGE class B, multislot class 33, UMTS 850 / 900 / 1700 / 1900 / 2100, HSDPA Cat9, up to 10.2 Mbps, HSUPA Cat5, up to 2.0 Mbps

Body.Dimensions: Width: 59 mm, Height: 115.5 mm, Thickness: 10.5 mm (11.7 mm around the camera area)

Platform.Operating system: Symbian Anna, upgradeable to Nokia Belle Refresh (111.140.0058)
Platform.CPU: ARM11 680 MHz, 3D Graphics Broadcom BCM2727 GPU with HW Accelerator supporting OpenGL-ES 2.0 and OpenVG1.1

Memory.Storage: 1024 MB internal NAND memory (350 MB available to user), 8 GB on-board memory
Memory.Card slot: Hot swap microSD/microSDHC card up to 32 GB supported

Display.Display: Transmissive LCD 640 × 480 px (VGA), 16.7 million colors (24 bits), 62.5 mm diagonally

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 MP (CMOS sensor) with EDoF, camera resolution of 3264px × 2448px, 720p at 25 frame/s or 640 × 480 at 30 frame/s, Digital zoom 2X for camera and 3X for video, Focus range : 50 cm to infinity
Cameras.Front camera: 0.3 MP (CMOS sensor), 176 × 144 at 15 frame/s for video calling

Battery.Battery: User replaceable BP-4L 3.7V 1500 mAh Li-Ion battery, micro USB charging, 2mm charging connector

Connectivity.Connectivity: WLAN IEEE 802.11 b/g/n (2.4 GHz), Bluetooth 3.0, Bluetooth Stereo Audio, micro USB 2.0, USB On-the-Go 1.3, USB 2.0 High-Speed, USB Mass Storage, MTP (Multimedia Transfer Protocol), GPS and A-GPS, Stereo FM radio with RDS (87.5-108 MHz or 76-90 MHz), 3.5 mm AV connector (TV out, audio in/out)
